_source: Emtaş solid fuel boilers (and one steel boiler for a burner), 45-100 kW, supplied through Sakra.
Figures read on 2026-09-24 off the technical-table images on sakra.com.tr, one per range:
https://www.sakra.com.tr/tr/urun/kazan  ->  each range's Dokümantasyon image, named under 'sheet' below.
Sakra's site shows Emtaş boilers: Emtaş model codes, 'emtaş' on every boiler in the photos, Emtaş named in the copy.
Only sizes of 45 kW and up to 100 kW are listed (the band asked for). kW is as printed on the sheet.
Values the sheets get visibly wrong are left out (null) rather than corrected by guesswork:
EKY/3K-45 depth printed as 9100 mm; EKYB/S weight and water copied from a smaller boiler.
Ranges 11 (4-pass 2-door) and 16 (5-pass baffled) publish no table, so they are not listed.
Photos: ქვაბები\Emtas\<range>, from sakra.com.tr; the versions with Turkish badges are set aside in სხვა.
